title: Reports of an Anthropic enterprise data retention policy change
reason: Fresh verifier sub-agent (10 searches/fetches) checked anthropic.com/news and site-scoped searches directly this cycle: no Tier-0 Anthropic primary source exists for this claim (no newsroom post, no trust-center update, no on-record spokesperson statement). The story rests on Bloomberg's original scoop (2026-08-20, anonymous 'source familiar with the matter') plus a same-day Reuters piece (via Yahoo Finance, byline Deborah Sophia) with its own but still-anonymous attribution -- independence between the two is uncertain, not clean. The Decoder's framing that developer Boris Cherny 'confirmed publicly on X' does not count as confirmation under policy (X/Twitter is Tier 3, discovery only): search-index snippets consistently show a matching post at x.com/bcherny/status/2090537902912815536, but this site's own rules bar an X post, even from a real Anthropic employee, from serving as confirmation, and the live page could not be fetched to verify firsthand (HTTP 402 on direct fetch). Fails the publishing gate on Tier-0/independence grounds -- holding, not dropping, since an Anthropic newsroom post seems plausible as the fall 2026 rollout approaches. dedup-check clean (no matches) as of this cycle.
watch: An Anthropic newsroom post, trust-center update, or on-record spokesperson statement confirming the policy change
A second outlet with its own independent sourcing (not anonymous, not relaying Bloomberg/Reuters)
Direct confirmation that the x.com/bcherny post is genuine and current
public_note: Reports describe a coming change to how Anthropic retains enterprise customer data; no official confirmation yet.
notes: 2026-08-23 c2: Opened this cycle from cycle 1's triage slate. Verifier found no Tier-0 source and only anonymous-sourced wire reporting; held as watching rather than published.
